Hello, we're Roots & Froots!

Roots & Froots started with the goal of making healthy choices easier while helping the community. As a local brand in Iloilo City, it continues to grow and find ways to reach more people while staying true to our values of quality, honesty, and caring for the environment. One of its featured products is Citroots Tisane, made with ginger, calamansi, and lemongrass.

Our Story

Every bottle of Citroots Tisane carries a little bit of Iloilo. Here's how Roots & Froots grows.

Grown with our community

Mission & Vision

Our Mission

To make wholesome, thoughtfully prepared food and beverages more accessible while supporting local agriculture, creating meaningful livelihood opportunities for marginalized communities, promoting mindful consumption, and contributing to healthier communities.

Our Vision

To become a trusted Filipino wellness food and beverage brand, proudly rooted in Iloilo, recognized for its authenticity, quality, and commitment to nurturing healthier communities, empowering livelihoods, and caring for the environment.

AccessibilityMaking wholesome food and beverage choices available to more Filipinos.

What's Inside

Calamansi

A small, tangy Filipino citrus. It brings the bright, zesty kick to every sip and is known for its natural vitamin C.

Ginger

A warming root with a gentle spice. Traditionally used to soothe the stomach, it gives the blend its cozy depth.

Lemongrass

A fragrant herb with a fresh, lemony aroma. Known for its clean, cleansing scent, it rounds out the flavor.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Citroots Tisane?
Citroots Tisane is our signature caffeine-free herbal infusion, freshly brewed in small batches using real ginger, calamansi, and lemongrass with a little cane sugar. No powdered mixes, just real ingredients.
Is Citroots Tisane caffeine-free?
Yes. It is naturally caffeine-free because we use herbs and citrus rather than tea leaves. It’s a refreshing option for those who prefer to avoid caffeine.
Is Citroots Tisane sweetened?
Yes, but only lightly. We add a little brown cane sugar to balance the natural tanginess of calamansi and the warmth of ginger. It’s refreshing without being overly sweet.
Can I return my empty glass bottles?

Absolutely! At Roots & Froots, we encourage bottle reuse and reward customers who help us reduce waste. Here’s how our bottle return rewards work:

  • 350ml and 495ml bottles: ₱5 off per eligible bottle returned
  • 995ml bottles: ₱10 off per eligible bottle returned

Please note:

  • Only original Roots & Froots Citroots Tisane glass bottles are eligible.
  • Bottles must be thoroughly rinsed immediately after use and completely air-dried before returning.
  • We accept only clean, dry, rust-free, and undamaged bottles with no residue, unpleasant odor, chips, or cracks.
  • Bottles are subject to inspection and acceptance by Roots & Froots.
  • Rewards are issued as discounts on your next direct purchase, not as cash refunds, and cannot be exchanged for cash.

Where to return? Please indicate your name when dropping off your bottles, or message us to coordinate your return.

Every bottle returned is one small step toward less waste and more mindful consumption. Thank you for going sustainable with us!

Is Citroots Tisane a medicinal drink?
No. Citroots Tisane is a refreshing herbal beverage, not a medicine or treatment. We created it to offer a thoughtfully prepared, caffeine-free drink made with familiar, locally sourced ingredients.
How often do you brew Citroots Tisane?
We currently brew fresh every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday in small batches. We recommend ordering ahead to reserve your bottles.
